entities.title: TypeScript library tests
entities.summary: The node:test suites of @utv/core: the shared fixtures, validation, the JSON layer, the typed layer and native interop, with the example suites under examples/.
entities.purpose: Checks the library without a browser: npm test compiles every *.test.ts into dist/test/ with tsc, then node --test runs them. Each suite reads the shared material from the repository root through a URL four levels above its compiled file.
boundaries: What each suite checks is recorded in verification.json here and in examples/.
shim.d.ts declares node:test and node:assert/strict so the project needs no @types/node.
The fixtures themselves belong to conformance/; this folder only runs them.
